en: Look at my powerful and well formed arms like two iron clubs, if once within them, even Shatakratu (Indra) cannot escape.

sa: प्रयास्यामि ततः पश्चात् पदवीं सव्यसाचिनः। यांस्त्वेतानपरान् राजन् नागान् सप्त शतानिमान्॥
en: I will follow from behind the track laid open by Savyasachin. Those other elephants, O monarch, full seven hundred in number.

sa: एकोऽर्थं विमृशेदेको धर्मे प्रकुरुते मनः। एकः कार्याणि कुरुते तमाहुर्मध्यमं नरम्॥
en: He belongs to the middle order who consults his own self only, depends on the Providence, and engages alone in works.

sa: शयनेषु परार्येषु ये पुरा वारणावते। नाधिजग्मुस्तदा निद्रां तेऽद्य सुप्ता महीतले॥
en: They who could not formerly sleep at Varanavata on the softest and costliest bed are now asleep on the bare ground!

sa: शक्यते दुस्त्यजेऽप्यर्थे चिररात्राय जीवितुम्। न तु भोजनमुत्सृज्य शक्यं वर्तयितुं चिरम्॥
en: A man can live many days even after forsaking his dear ones, but be cannot live long after abstaining from food.

sa: ततोऽहं त्वामुपस्थास्ये सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते। एवमुक्तः स इन्द्राण्या नहुषः प्रीतिमानभूत्॥
en: Then shall I attend on you; I speak sincerely." Being thus addressed by the queen of Indra, Nahusha became highly pleased.

sa: तारितोऽहं त्वया पुत्र सुपुत्रेण महात्मना। अष्टावक्रेण धर्मात्मा कहोलो ब्राह्मणो यथा॥
en: I have been emancipated, O my son, through you-a good and high-souled son, as the virtuoussouled Brāhmaṇa Kahola was by Aștāvakra.

sa: एवं ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे कैकेय्या भयमागतम्। मुखं चाप्यगमच्छोषं स्वरश्चापि व्यरुध्यत ॥
en: When that descendant of Kākutstha said this, Kaikeyi was inspired with apprehension: her countenance became blank, and her utterance was choked.

sa: सम्प्रहृष्टा वचः श्रुत्वा खरस्य वदनाच्च्युतम्। प्रशशंस पुनर्मोाद् भ्रातरं रक्षसां वरम्॥
en: Overjoyed on hearing the words that dropped from Khara's mouth, she again through fickleness extolled that foremost of Rākşasas, her brother.

sa: कन्यामरगर्भाभा ज्वलन्तीमिव च श्रिया। तां ददर्श समुत्सृष्टां नदीतीरे महानृषिः॥ स्थूलकेशः स तेजस्वी विजने बन्धुवर्जिताम्। स तां दृष्ट्वा तदा कन्यां स्थूलकेशो महाद्विजः॥
en: The great Rishi saw the girl lying forsaken in a lonely place on the banks of the river, blazing in beauty; she was as beautiful as a child of an immortal. And the great Brahmana, Sthulakesha, the chief of Munis, finding that female child.

sa: तथा द्रोणेन समरे निगृहीतेषु पाण्डुषु। कथं युद्धमभूत् तत्र तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: O Sanjaya, relate to me also how the battle raged there where Drona began to crush the Pandava host in battle.

sa: तस्मिन्नेव तदा तीर्थे सिन्धुद्वीपः प्रतापवान्। देवापिश्च महाराज ब्राह्मण्यं प्रापतुर्मह ॥
en: In that very tirtha, in the Krita age th greatly energetic Sindhudvipa and Devapi also, had acquired the dignity of Brahman-hood.

sa: ततः कतिपयाहस्य ब्राह्मणः संशितव्रतः। प्रतिश्रयार्थी तद् वेश्म ब्राह्मणस्य जगाम ह॥
en: A few days after, a Brahmana of rigid Vows came to the house of the Brahmana in order to live there.

sa: तेषां ह्यकामकरणाद् राज्ञः संजायते भयम्। मित्राणि न च वर्धन्ते तथामित्रीभवन्त्यपि॥
en: Neglecting to please Brahmanas the king brings danger on himself, for such neglect, he cannot acquire friends while his enemies multiply.

sa: कथं जीवेयुरत्यन्तं कथं वर्धयुरित्यपि। इति दीनेषु पार्थेषु मनो मे परितप्यते॥
en: "How might they save their lives how might they thrive?" Such thoughts about the distressed sons of Pritha make me aggrieved.

sa: फलार्थोऽयं समारम्भो लोके पुंसां विपश्चिताम्। वहेदमित्रं स्कन्धेन यावत् कालस्य पर्ययः॥
en: So this method should be adopted in destroying one's own enemies. Carry your enemy on your shoulder till the time comes.

sa: व्यभिचाराच्च तस्मात् सा क्लिन्नाम्भसि विचेतना। प्रविवेशाश्रमं त्रस्ता तां वै भर्तान्वबुध्यत॥
en: Being unable to control her this unlawful desire, she became polluted; she then returned to the hermitage much frightened at heart.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं चैव ततो जयमुदीरयेत्॥
en: Having saluted Narayana and Nara the best of male beings as also the Goddess of Learning, let us shout about success.

sa: ततः स राजा नहुषो विस्मितः प्रेक्ष्य धीवरान्। आरोहमाणांस्त्रिदिवं मत्स्यांश्च भरतर्षभ॥
en: Seeing the fishermen ascending to heaven with those fishes in their company, became filled with wonder, O chief of Bharata's race.

sa: अभिष्वङ्गस्तु कामेषु महामोह इति स्मृतः। ऋषयो मुनयो देवा मुह्यन्त्यत्र सुखेप्सवः॥
en: Attachment to objects of desire is considered as great delusion. Here Rishis and Munis and celestials become deluded, desirous of pleasure.

sa: गुरुरुवाच इत्युक्तास्ते तु मुनयो गुरुणा ब्रह्मणा तथा। कृतवन्तो महात्मानस्ततो लोकमवाप्नुवन्॥
en: The Preceptor said, Thus addressed by the preceptor Brahman, those great sages acted accordingly and then attained to many happy regions.

sa: प्रश्नं तु वाङ्मनसोर्मा यस्मात् त्वमनुपृच्छसि। तस्मात् ते वर्तयिष्यामि तयोरेव समाह्वयम्॥
en: But since you ask me a question about word and mind, I shall, therefore, describe to you a discourse between them.

sa: ततः कदाचिद् राजेन्द्र काष्ठान्यानयितुं ययौ॥ उत्तङ्कः काष्ठभारं च महान्तं समुपानयत्।
en: One day, he started, O king for fetching fuel for his preceptor. Soon after Utanka brought a heavy load of fuel.

sa: लोहपिण्डं यथा वह्निः प्रविश्य ह्यतितापयेत्। तथा त्वमपि जानीहि गर्भे जीवापपादनम्॥
en: As fire, entering a mass of iron, heats it greatly, so is the manifestation of the Individual Soul in the foetus.

sa: तस्य तैः कारणैर्जन्तोः शरीरं च्यवते तदा। जीवितं प्रोच्यमानं तदृ यथावदुपधारय॥
en: Through these causes the living body of the creature dissolves away. Understand correctly the manner as I declare it to you.

sa: मा जुगुप्सां कृथाः पुत्र त्वमत्रार्थे कथंचन। त्वयैतद्धि समाचीर्णं गौतमस्याश्रमे तदा।॥
en: Do not hate to do my order, O son. You did it often at the hermitage of Gautama in former days.

sa: स गत्वा त्वरितो राजन् गौतमस्य निवेशनम्। प्रायच्छत् कुण्डले दिव्ये गुरुपत्न्यास्तदानघ॥
en: Indeed, going quickly to Gautama's hermitage, O king, he presented those earrings to the wife of his preceptor, O sinless one.

sa: यदि त्वहं त्वां दुर्वृत्तमद्राक्षं द्विजसत्तम। शपेयं त्वामहं क्रोधान्न मेऽत्रास्ति विचारणा॥
en: O best of Brahmanas, if I had known you to have acted wickedly, I would, without hesitation, have cursed you entirely.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शृण्वतां तु महाराज कथां तां लोमहर्षणाम्। दुःखशोकपरिक्लेशा वृष्णीनामभवंस्तदा।॥
en: Vaishampayana continued : The Vrishnis, as they heard, O king, that dreadful account became filled with grief and sorrow and pain.

sa: ततस्तु पाण्डवाः सर्वे द्रौपदी च यशस्विनी। युधिष्ठिरस्य तद् वाक्यं बाढमित्यभ्यपूजयन्॥
en: At this, all the Pandavas with the famous Draupadi amongst them, highly spoke of the words of Yudhishthira and said, yes.'

sa: इत्युक्तः स तु धर्मात्मा कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। अश्वमेधस्य कौरव्य चकाराहरणे मतिम्॥
en: Vaishmpayana said Thus addressed, the Kuru-King Yudhishthira of righteous soul, O monarch, began to make the necessary preparations for the Horse-Sacrifice.

sa: न तु बालानिमान् दीनानुत्सहे वसु याचितुम्। तथैवाईव्रणान् कृच्छ्रे वर्तमानान् नृपात्मजान्॥
en: Nor can I for riches solicit these young sons of kings, living wretchedly with their wounds yet green, and undergoing suffering.

sa: तमेवं वादिनं पार्थं व्यासः प्रोवाच धर्मवित्॥ सान्त्वयन् सुमहातेजाः शुभं वचनमर्थवत्।
en: As Pritha's son was speaking thus, the highly energetic Vyasa, knowing the duties of life, soothing him, spoke these excellent words.

sa: अथ नेच्छसि राजानं कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। मेढीभूतः स्वयं राज्यं प्रतिगृह्णीष्व पार्थिव॥ समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु वर्तमानं नराधिप। अनुजीवन्तु सर्वे त्वां ज्ञातयो भ्रातृभिः सह।॥
en: If you would not have king Yudhishthira, son of Kunti, then, O monarch, you yourself, celebrating a sacrifice, take charge of the kingdom, and regarding all creatures impartially, ( king, you let your kinsmen, O you benefactor of your kindred, subsist on your bounty.

sa: ययोः पुत्रशतं नष्टं स्वप्नलब्धं यथा धनम्॥ अश्रुत्वा हितकामस्य विदुरस्य महात्मनः।
en: Not having listened to the weighty words of the great Vidura, who sought our well-being, I, of perverse senses, (now) repent.

sa: छित्त्वा तु तानाशु चैव कङ्कपत्रशिलाशितान्॥ एकैकमेषां समरे बिभेद निशितैः शरैः।
en: Having off those sharp arrows bedecked with Kanka-feathers, Arjuna pierced each of the warriors opposed to him with a whetted arrow.

sa: एवं पापैर्विनिर्मुक्तस्त्वं पूतः स्वर्गमाप्स्यसि। संचयित्वा पुनः कोशं यद् राष्ट्र पालयिष्यसि॥
en: Purged off of sin, you are sure of attaining to Heaven. Filling your treasury, you should do good to your kingdom.

sa: किंतु सर्वापराधोऽयं यदि तेऽद्य धनंजयः। क्षमस्व याच्यमाना वै जीवयस्व धनंजयम्॥
en: If Dhananjaya has offended against you in every respect, do you forgive him! I solicit you, do you revive that hero.

sa: भीष्मं हि कुरुशार्दूलमुद्यतेषु महारणे॥ न शक्त: संयुगे हन्तुं साक्षादपि शतक्रतुः।
en: The very king of the celestials himself could not kill Bhishma in battle when he stood with stretched bow in hand.

sa: सा न्यवारदव्यग्रं तं पुत्र युद्ध दुर्मदम्। प्रसादयामास च तं जिष्णुमक्लिष्टकारिणम्॥
en: She forbade her brave son of steady heart from fighting any longer, and pleased Jishnu who was never fatigued with toil.

sa: इत्युक्तः स तु तेजस्वी व्यासेनामितबुद्धिना। दीक्षां विवेश धर्मात्मा वाजिमेधाप्तये ततः॥
en: Thus addressed by Vyasa of incomparable intelligence, the righteous-souled Yudhishthria of great energy underwent the initiation for performance of the Horse-Sacrifice.

sa: द्वैपायनस्तथा कृष्णः पुनरेव युधिष्ठिरम्॥ प्रोवाच मध्ये विप्राणामिदं सम्पूजयन् मुनिः। दत्तैषां भवता मह्यं तां ते प्रतिददाम्यहम्॥ हिरण्यं दीयतामेभ्यो ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धरास्तु ते।
en: The Island-born Krishna, highly applauding him, once more addressed Yudhishthira, before the Brahmanas, saying, "The Earth has been given by you to me!' I, however, give her back to you! Do you give to these Brahmanas gold. Let the Earth be yours!'

sa: तथा विट्शूद्र संघाश्च तथान्ये म्लेच्छजातयः॥ ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे मुदिता जग्मुरालयान्।
en: Thus pleased with presents inade by king Yudhishthira of great intelligence, the Brahmanas, filled with joy, returned to their respective abodes.

sa: भक्ष्यखाण्डवरागाणां क्रिबतां भुज्यतां तथा। पशूनां बध्यतां चैव नान्तं ददृशिरे जनाः॥
en: Of men employed in making and eating the sweetmeats called Khandavaragas, and of animals killed for food, there was no end.

sa: किमिदं ते व्यवसितं नैव त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि। न त्वामभ्यनुजानामि प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: What, indeed, is your object? You should not do it. I can never grant you permission! you should show us mercy.

sa: यान् समुद्दिश्य संकल्पः पयसोऽस्य कृतो मया। पितरस्ते महाभागास्तेभ्यो बुद्ध्यस्व गम्यताम्॥
en: Those for whom I had kept this milk are the highly blessed Pitris. Present yourself before them and ascertain their intentions.

sa: ते वै यदि नरास्तस्मान्निरयादुत्तरन्ति वै। वर्षपूगैस्ततो जन्म लभन्ते कुत्सिते कुले॥
en: When their sufferings terminate after many years, they rise from Hell and take birth as men, in low and wretched families.

sa: तमन्वगच्छद् विदुरो विद्वान् सूतश्च संजयः। स चापि परमेष्वासः कृपः शारद्वतस्तथा॥
en: He was followed by the highly learned Vidura, and his charioteer Sanjaya, as also that powerful bowman Kripa the of Sharadvata.

sa: कस्माद् दानं सुवर्णस्य पूजयन्ति मनीषिणः। कस्माच्च दक्षिणार्थं तद् यज्ञकर्मसु शस्यते॥
en: Why do wise men applaud the gift of gold? Why is gold considered as the best of presents in all sacrifices?

sa: नरर्षभम्। एतच्छुत्वा तु वचनं विदुरस्य युधिष्ठिरः॥ हृष्टः सम्पूजयामास गुडाकेशश्च पाण्डवः।
en: Hearing these words of Vidura, both Yudhishthira, and Pandus' son Arjuna of curly hair, became very glad and applauded them highly.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु राज्ञा स विदुरो बुद्धिसत्तमः। धृतराष्ट्रमुपेत्यैवं वाक्यमाह महार्थवत्॥ उक्तो युधिष्ठिरो राजा भवद्वचनमादितः। स च संश्रुत्य वाक्यं ते प्रशशंस महाद्युतिः॥
en: Thus addressed by king Yudhishthira, Vidura, that foremost of intelligent persons, returned to Dhritarashtra and said to hin these words of great significance, 'I at first reported your message to king Yudhishthira, Reflecting on your words, Yudhishthira of great splendour spoke highly of them.

sa: गृहेषु स्वनिवासेषु सुखेषु शयनेषु च। वराहेषु महाभाग स्वपामि च सुपूजितः॥
en: Adored by all, I sleep, O highly blessed one on rich beds in charming rooms to which disagreeable winds cannot blow.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्य जननी स हि धर्मः सनातनः। वयमेतत् प्रपश्यामो नृपते दिव्यचक्षुषा॥
en: She is the mother of Yudhishthria who is the eternal Dharma. We see all this, O king, with out spiritual vision.

sa: सद्यो वर्धयति प्राणान् पुष्टिमय्यां दधाति च। न भक्ष्योऽभ्यधिकः कश्चिन्मांसादस्ति परंतप॥
en: Meat quickly increases strength. It ordains great development. There is no food. O scorcher of enemies, that is superior to meat.

sa: परं निर्वेदमगमंश्चिन्तयन्तो नराधिपम्। तं च ज्ञातिवधं घोरं संस्मरन्तः पुनः पुनः॥
en: Despair entered their souls as they thought of the old king and as they repeated, of that terrible destruction of kinsinen.

sa: गङ्गोर्मिभिरथो दिग्धः पुरुषं पवनो यदा। स्पृशते सोऽस्य पाप्मानं सद्य एवापकर्षति॥
en: When the wind which is moistened with the particles of Gangawater touches one's body, it cleanses him immediately of every sin.

sa: ददाति यजते चापि तपस्वी च भवत्यपि। मधुमांसनिवृत्त्येति प्राहु चैवं बृहस्पतिः॥
en: Brihaspati has said that that man who abstains from honey and meat, gains the merit of gifts and sacrifices and penances.

sa: अधर्मस्य क्षयं गत्वा ततो जायति मानुषः। चोरयित्वा पयश्चापि बलाका सम्प्रजायते॥
en: After the exhaustion of his sin by such suffering he regains the human form. By stealing milk, one becomes a crane.

sa: मृतं शरीर हि नृणां सूक्ष्ममव्यक्ततां गतम्॥ अचक्षुर्विषयं प्राप्तं कथं धर्मोऽनुगच्छति।
en: The dead body of man becomes subtile and unmanifest. It becomes invisible. How is it possible for virtue to follow it?

sa: ततो धर्मसुतो राजा भगवन्तं बृहस्पतिम्। उपगम्य यथान्यायं प्रश्न पप्रच्छ तत्त्वतः॥
en: Then approaching the illustrious Brihaspati, Dharma's royal son, Yudhishthira, asked him the question in proper form, desirous of knowing the truth.

sa: सतामृषिस्तदा क्रुद्वो वाक्यमाह शुभाननाम्। रेणुके किं चिरेण त्वमागतेति पुनः पुनः॥
en: The Rishis, stricken with anger, repeatedly addressed his fairfaced wife, saying, O Renuka, why have you been so late in returning?

sa: यावन्ति रोमकूपाणि तस्य गात्रेषु पाण्डव। तावन्त्येव सहस्राणि वर्षाणां दिवि मोदते॥
en: Such a person enjoys all sorts of happiness in Heaven for as many years as there are pores in his body.

sa: एतस्य त्वपनीतस्य समाधि तात चिन्तय। यथा सुखगमः पन्था भवेत् त्वद्रश्मिभावितः॥
en: Do you, therefore, think of some remedy for this evil, by which people may be relieved when heated by your rays.

sa: सुवर्णस्त्वब्रवीद् वाक्यं मनुं स्वायम्भुवं प्रति। हितार्थं सर्वभूतानां प्रश्न मे वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Then Suvarna addressing the Selfcreate Manu, said these words:You should answer one question of mine for the behoof of all creatures.

sa: तावुत्थायासनं हित्वा जग्मतुर्यत्र सा स्थिता। उभौ च कामसम्मत्तावुभौ प्राथर्यतश्च ताम्॥
en: Leaving their seat, they immediately went to the place where she was. Both being full of desire, both sought her favours.

sa: यः स कौरव्य दायादः पाण्डुर्नाम नराधिपः। कामभोगान् परित्यज्य शतशृङ्गमितो गतः॥
en: "The descendant of Kuru, the king, named Pandu, after abandoning pleasure and luxury, went to the mountain with the thousand peaks.

sa: शक्तिरस्य महोत्साहा न ह्यशक्तः स्वयं व्रजेत्। न च तद्विद्यते किंचित् कर्म लोकेषु यद्भवेत्॥ ब्राह्मणानामसाध्यं च नृषु संस्थानचारिषु। अब्भक्षा वायुभक्षाश्च फलाहारा दृढव्रताः॥
en: He has (surely great) strength and great energy, else he would not have gone of his own accord. There is nothing in the three worlds that Brahmanas among all mortal men cannot accomplish. Abstaining from food, living on air, eating fruits, observing severe vows,

sa: तमुवाच महाप्राज्ञो जरत्करुमहातपाः। किं नाम्नी भगिनीयं ते ब्रूहि सत्यं भुजंगम॥
en: Then Jaratkaru, the great ascetic of rigid austerities, said, “O snake tell me truly what is the name of your sister?”

sa: ततः सा रङ्गमध्यस्थं तेषां राज्ञां मनस्विनी। ददर्श राजशार्दूलं पाण्डुं भरतसत्तमम्॥
en: The intelligent Kunti saw that best of kings, the foremost of the Bharata race, Pandu, in the assembly of the kings.

sa: लोभश्चापि न कर्तव्यः स्वल्पोऽपि धनवाञ्छया। किं धनेनाश्रमस्थानां फलमूलाशिनां सदा ॥
en: Do not cherish the least longing for riches. Of what avail is wealth to ascetics living perpetually on fruits and roots?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तं निश्चितात्मानं युद्धाय यदुनन्दनः। उवाच वाग्मी राजानं जरासंधमधोक्षजः॥
en: Vaishampayana said The excellent speaker, the descendant of Yadu (Krishna), then thus addressed the king Jarasandha who was resolved upon fight.

sa: किं ते कार्यं महाभाग बूहि विस्रब्धमानसः। लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सारमेयोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: "O generous sir, what business has brought you hither-do you relate it confidentially.” Hearing the words of Lakşmaņa the dog replied.

sa: रवं स भैरवं कृत्वा समुद्यम्य करावुभौ। अभ्यद्रवद् भीमसेनं जिघांसुः पुरुषादकः॥
en: Uttering a fearful yell, the cannibal rushed on Bhima with two arms raised high and with the intention of killing Bhimasena.

sa: स राजसूयं राजेन्द्र कुरूणामृषभस्तदा। आहर्तुं प्रवणं चक्रे मनः संचिन्त्य चासकृत्॥
en: O king of kings, having reflected much, the best of the Kurus, (Yudhishthira) resolved to make preparations to perform that sacrifice.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच जरत्कारुर्जरत्कारुं यां भार्यां समवाप्स्यति। तत्र जातो द्विजः शापान्मोक्षयिष्यति पन्नगान्॥
en: Brahma said : Jaratkaru will marry wife named Jaratkaru. That Brahmana, who will be born of her, will save the snakes.

sa: शक्तिं चापि हि धर्मज्ञं नातिक्रान्तुमिहार्हसि। प्रजायाश्च ममोच्छेदं न चैवं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: You should not transgress against Shakti who was learned in all the precepts of religion. You should not exterminate my creatures.

sa: न तु सोमकुलोत्पन्ने वंशे स्थास्यति दुर्मतेः। वंशोऽपि भवतस्तुल्यो दुविनीतो भविष्यति॥
en: O vicious minded; your descendants shall be degraded from the lunar race and your children shall be equally vicious-minded like you.

sa: स सर्पसत्रात्किल नो मोक्षयिष्यति वीर्यवान्। एवं पितामहः पूर्वमुक्तवांस्तु सुरैः सह॥
en: That greatly powerful being will be able to from the Snake-sacrifice. The Grandsire told this to the celestials in olden times.

sa: तेनेह क्षुधितेनाद्य श्रान्तेन च तपस्विना। अजानता कृतं मन्ये व्रतमेतदिदं मम॥
en: That penance-practising king oppressed by hunger and thirst and he did not know that I was observing the vow of silence.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः क्षिप्तमिवात्मानं मत्वा पार्थोऽभ्यभाषत। कर्ण भ्रातृसमूहस्य मध्येऽचलमिव स्थितम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon Partha considered himself disgraced and spoke to Karna who stood amidst the (Kuru) brothers like a hill.

sa: अभिपूज्य महात्मानं भीमं भीमपराक्रमम्। पुनरेवार्जुनो वाक्यमुवाचेदं वृकोदरम्॥ न दूरं नगरं मन्ये वनादस्मादहं विभो। शीघ्रं गच्छाम भद्रं ते न नो विद्यात् सुयोधनः॥
en: Thus congratulating the illustrious and greatly powerful Bhima, Arjuna thus again addressed Vrikodara, "O lord, I believe there is a town not far off from this forest. O blessed one, let us soon go from this place, so that Duryodhana may not trace us."

sa: एवं कौतूहलं कृत्वा दृष्ट्वा च प्रतिगृह्य च। सहास्माभिर्महात्मानः पुनः प्रतिनिवर्व्यथ॥
en: O high-souled men seeing all these wonderful sights and taking what will be given away, you will also return with us.

sa: अथचीकादयोऽभ्येत्य पितरो राममब्रुवन्। राम राम महाभाग प्रीताः स्म तव भार्गव॥
en: Thereupon Richika and others of his ancestors appeared and said, "Rama, O blessed Rama, O son of Bhrigu, we are pleased

sa: श्रूयते हि पुरा कश्चिदम्बुवीच इतीश्वरः। आसीद् राजगृहे राजा मागधानां महीक्षिताम्॥
en: We have heard that there was a king of old, named Ambuvich, who was the king at Rajgriha over the Magadhas.

sa: शम एव यतीनां हि क्षमिणां सिद्धिकारकः। क्षमावतामयं लोकः परश्चैव क्षमावताम्॥
en: Peacefulness produces success to the forgiving ascetics. Good come to the forgiving men, both in this world and in the next.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा ततो बाहुं प्रगृह्य पुरुषादकः। अभ्यद्रवत संक्रुद्धो भीमसेनमरिंदमम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this, the cannibal, outstretching his arms, ran in great wrath towards that chastiser of foes, Bhimasena.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो राज्ञां चरैराप्तैः प्रवृत्तिरुपनीयत। पाण्डवैरुपसम्पन्ना द्रौपदी पतिभिः शुभा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thereupon the kings knew from their trusted spies that the beautiful Draupadi had got the Pandavas her husbands;

sa: विश्वकर्मा महाभागो जज्ञे शिल्पप्रजापतिः। कर्ता शिल्पसहस्राणां त्रिदशानां च वर्धकिः॥ भूषाणानां च सर्वेषां कर्ता शिल्पवतां वरः। यो दिव्यानि विमानानि त्रिदशानां चकार ह॥
en: She gave birth to the illustrious Vishvakarma, the founder of all arts, the creator of thousand arts, the artist of the celestials, the maker of all kinds of ornaments, the best of all artists and the maker of the celestials cars of the gods.

sa: तस्य तद् दुष्करं कर्म प्रशशंसुर्नराधिपाः। समेताश्च पृथक् चैव भीष्मोऽयमिति चाब्रुवन्॥
en: All the assembled chiefs and potentates applauded him jointly and individually for his great act. They exclaimed, “He is (really) Bhishma."

sa: अपश्यमानो वैदेहीं मेने शून्यमिदं जगत्। शोकेन परमायस्तो न शान्ति मनसागमत्॥
en: In Janaki's absence the whuic orld appeared to him as blank. Now being overwhelmed with grief he lost all mental peace.

sa: यस्य दुर्योधनो वीर्यं चिन्तयन्नमितौजसः। न शेते रजनी: सर्वा दुःखाच्छकुनिना सह॥
en: Remembering whose great prowess, Duryodhana with Sakuni and all others do not sleep (for a moment) in the night in anxiety;

sa: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा पूरुमथाब्रवीत्। इयं जरा महाबाहो मदर्थं प्रतिगृह्यताम्॥
en: Hearing the words of Yadu, Yayāti said to Puru: “O you having large arms, do you take the decrepitude for me."

sa: यत्र सर्वक्षयं कृत्वा तावुभौ रामकेशवौ। नातिचक्रामतुः कालं प्राप्तं सर्वहरं महत्॥
en: It then relates that Rama and Krishna, after destroying their race, did not rise superior to the way of all-destroying time.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच धनंजयवचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। स्निग्धगम्भीरनादिन्या तं गिरा प्रत्यभाषत।॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard the words of Dhananjaya (Arjuna), Dharmaraja Yudhishthira thus replied to him in a grave and calm voice.

sa: न चैनमभ्यजास्ते तदा विकृतदर्शनम्। अथैनं परिपप्रच्छुः को भवान् कस्य वेत्युत॥
en: Seeing that man of grim visage, a total stranger to them, they asked, “Who are you and whose son are you?"

sa: शून्यामेव च पश्यामि पृथिवीं पृथुलोचन। अपि स्वस्ति भवेत्तस्य भ्रातुस्ते भ्रातृवत्सल॥
en: I behold the earth as void of all happiness. O you fond of brothers— has your brother met with any calamity?

sa: स तात इति विप्रर्षिर्वसिष्ठं प्रत्यभाषत। मातुः समक्षं कौन्तेय अदृश्यन्त्याः परंतपः॥
en: O son of Kunti, O chastiser of foes the child called the Brahmana Rishi Vasishtha as "father" before his mother Adrishyanti.

sa: प्राप्य दक्षिणमूरूं मे त्वमश्लिष्टा वराङ्गने। अपत्यानां स्नुषाणां च भीरु विद्ध्येतदासनम्॥
en: O beautiful lady, you have sat upon my right thigh. O timid girl, it is the seat for daughters and daughters-in-law.

sa: नानृतं तचिकीर्षामि क्रुद्धो युष्मान् यदब्रुवम्। न प्रजास्यति चाप्येष मानुषेषु महामनाः॥
en: I shall not make my words futile though uttered in anger. But Dyo shall not beget offspring when dwelling on earth.

sa: यदाज्ञप्तं महाराज सर्व तत्कृतवानहम्। हतः स लवणः पापः पुरी चास्य निवेशिता॥ द्वादशैतानि वर्षाणि त्वां विना रघुनन्दन। नोत्सहेयमहं वस्तुं त्वया विरहितो नृप॥
en: O great king, I have carried out all your behests; I have slain the vicious Lavaņa and filled his city with subjects. O descendant of Raghu, twelve years have passed away without you, I do not wish to live any longer separated from you.

sa: किंतु लध्वर्थसंयुक्तं प्रियाख्यानं न मामति। प्रीणात्यतो भवान् भूयो विस्तरेण ब्रवीतु मे॥ एतामेव कथां दिव्यामाप्रजापतितो मनोः। तेषामाजननं पुण्यं कस्य न प्रीतिमावहेत्॥
en: But I am not still satiated with this charming account, for it is so short. Therefore, narrate to me in detail. This delightful history, commencing from Prajapati Manu. Who will not feel delight in hearing such an account, sacred as it is.

sa: अथ कस्मान्मद्विशिष्टो लोकादपि च वीर्यवान्। अन्योऽस्ति भवतः शिष्यो निषादाधिपतेः सुतः॥
en: Why then there is a pupil of yours in the world (equal to me), the mighty son of the Nishada king?"

sa: ततः प्रतिनिवृत्तः स तया वध्वा सहानघ। कल्माषपादमासीनं ददर्श विजने वने।॥
en: The sinless (Rishi), accomplished by his daughter-in-law, returned (to his hermitage). He saw (one day) Kalmashapada sitting in a solitary forest.

sa: दुःखाच्चाश्रूणि मुमुचे पितरं चेदमब्रवीत्। श्रुत्वेमां धर्षणां तात तव तेन दुरात्मना॥
en: He shed tears in grief; and addressed his father thus, “O father, hearing the insult offered to you by the miscreant,

sa: उत्पत्स्यति रुरुर्नाम प्रमतेरात्मजः शुचिः। तं दृष्ट्वा शापमोक्षस्ते भविता न चिरादिव॥
en: When Ruru the holy, the son of Pramati will appear, you will be immediately relieved of the curse on seeing him.”

sa: भारतस्य वपुर्खेतत्सत्यं चामृतमेव च। नवनीतं यथा दध्मो द्विपदां ब्राह्मणो यथा॥
en: In the body of Bharata this chapter, is truth and ambrosia; as butter is among curds and a Brahmana among bipeds.

sa: तदा प्रभृति लोकेऽस्मिन् महाभारतमुच्यते। महत्त्वे च गुरुत्वे च ध्रियमाणं यतोऽधिकम्॥
en: From that time, it is called Mahabharata. It is considered superior to the Vedas, both in substance and gravity of import.

sa: भृगवस्तु ददुः केचित् तेषां वित्तं यथेप्सितम्॥ क्षत्रियाणां तदा तात कारणान्तरदर्शनात्।
en: O son, some of the Bhrigus, finding no other alternative, gave their wealth to the Kshatriyas as much as they desired.

sa: स तां माद्रीमुपादाय भीष्मः सागरगासुतः। आजगाम पुरीं धीमान् प्रविष्टो गजसाह्वयम्॥
en: The son of ocean going Ganga, intelligent Bhishma, taking Madri with him, returned to the capital, named after the elephant (Hastinapur).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पौरजानपदैस्तुष्टैरित्युक्तो नाहुषस्तदा। अभ्यषिञ्चत् तत: पूरुं राज्ये स्वे सुतमात्मनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Having been thus addressed the contented people the son of Nahusha (Yayati) installed his son Puru on the throne.

sa: प्रतिषेद्वा हि पापस्य यदा लोकेषु विद्यते। तदा सर्वेषु लोकेषु पापकृन्नोपपद्यते॥
en: If there be a punisher of crimes in the world, no one in all the worlds could dare commit a crime.

sa: यौवनेन चरन् कामान् युवा युवतिभिः सह। विहर्तुमहमिच्छामि साह्यं कुरुत पुत्रकाः॥
en: “O Dear sons, I wish to be young and desire to pass my time with young women. Help me in this."

sa: तान् भृगूणां यदा दारान् कश्चिन्नाभ्युपपद्यत। माता तदा दधारेयमूरुणैकेन मां शुभा॥
en: When the Bhrigu women did not find a single protector, my blessed mother held me (hidden) in one of her thighs.

sa: स गत्वा परमप्रीतो मातुलं मातरं च ताम्। अभिगम्योपसंगृह्य तथावृत्तं न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Having returned in great joy to his uncle and mother, he touched their feet and told them all that had happened.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा जीवितं वृक्षं काश्यपेन महात्मना। उवाच तक्षको ब्रह्मन्नैतदत्यद्भुतं त्वयि॥
en: Seeing that the tree was really revived by the illustrious Kashyapa, Takshaka said, “O Brahmana, it is not (at all) wonderful.

sa: स त्वं रुरुरितिख्यातः प्रमतेरात्मजोऽपि च। स्वरूपं प्रतिपद्याहमद्य वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्॥
en: You are the very Ruru, the son of Pramati. Now regaining my natural form I shall speak something for your benefit.

sa: ततस्तस्य नगस्थस्य क्षुरेण निशितेन च। शिर उत्कृत्य तरसा पातयामास पाण्डवः॥
en: The Pandava (Arjuna) speedily struck off the head of the vulture with his sharp arrow and brought it to the ground.

sa: तस्मात्प्राणभृतः सर्वान्न हिंस्याब्राह्मणः क्वचित्। ब्राह्मणः सौम्य एवेह भवतीति परा श्रुतिः॥
en: Therefore, a Brahmana should never hurt any creature. The injunction of the Shruti is that a Brahmana should always be mild.

sa: देवतायतनानां च प्रेक्ष्य पूजां कृतां द्विजैः। ब्रह्मलोकस्थमात्मानं मेने स नृपसत्तमः॥
en: That best of kings, seeing the rites with which the Brahmanas worshipped the deities, thought himself in the land of Brahma.

sa: प्रतीपस्तु महीपालस्तामुवाच यशस्विनीम्। करोमि किं ते कल्याणि प्रियं यत् तेऽभिकासितम्॥
en: Thereupon, the king Pratipa asked that famous "O fortunate lady, what good can I do to you and which you desire?"

sa: पश्यन्तो रमणीयानि वनानि च सरांसि च। तत्र तत्र वसन्तश्च शनैर्जग्मुर्महारथाः॥
en: Those great car-warriors slowly walked on, stopping on forests and on (the banks of) lakes which they found to be charming.

sa: तुर्वसो प्रतिपद्यस्व पाप्मानं जरया सह। यौवनेन चरेयं वै विषयांस्तव पुत्रक॥
en: O Turvasu, take upon yourself my decrepitude and consequent weakness. I wish to enjoy the pleasures of life with your youth.

sa: ततः स भूयः संक्रुद्धो वृक्षमादाय राक्षसः। ताडयिष्यंस्तदा भीमं पुनरभ्यद्रवद् बली॥
en: Thereupon he (the Rakshasas) became very angry, tore up a tree and ran at the strong Bhima to strike him again.

sa: स धर्मशास्त्रकुशलं भीष्मं शान्तनवं नृपः। पूजयामास धर्मेण स चैनं प्रत्यपालयत्॥
en: He adopted the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, learned in the Shastras of religion and law. He too protected him very virtuously.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय सत्यजिद् वेगवत्तरम्। सावं ससूतं सरथं पार्थं विव्याध सत्वरः॥
en: But Satyajit immediately took up an other bow and he soon pierced with arrows Partha, with his chariot, charioteer and horses.

sa: अस्याख्यानस्य विषये पुराणं वर्तते द्विजाः। अन्तरिक्षस्य विषये प्रजा इव चतुर्विधाः॥
en: O Brahmanas, as four kinds of creatures depend on space for their existence so all the Puranas depend on this history,

sa: अब्रवीदिति मां भीष्म वचनं प्रीतिवर्धनम्। अहं प्रियतमः पुत्रः पितुर्दोण महात्मनः॥
en: O Bhishma he used to tell me these gratifying words, “O Drona, I am the favourite son of my illustrious father.

sa: सौतिरुवाच स श्रुत्वाऽथात्मनो देहं सुपर्णः प्रेक्ष्य च स्वयम्। शरीरप्रतिसंहारमात्मनः संप्रचक्रमे॥
en: Sauti said : Having heard (of the hugeness of his body) and seeing it himself, he began to diminish his body.

sa: तस्याः शक्रस्य पूजार्थं भूमौ भूमिपतिस्तदा। प्रवेशं कारयामास गते संवत्सरे सदा॥
en: After the expiration of a year, the king planted it on the ground for the purpose of worshipping the giver, (Indra.)

sa: ततः पाशैस्तदाऽऽत्मानं गाढं बद्धवा महामुनिः। तस्या जले महानद्या निममज्ज सुदुःखितः॥
en: Thereupon the great Rishi tied himself with very strong cords and fell in grief into the waters of that great river.

sa: तं वसिष्ठादयः सर्वे मुनयस्तत्र मेनिरे। तेजसा दीप्यमानं वै द्वितीयमिव भास्करम्॥
en: Then Vasishtha and the other Rishis regarded that Rishi, blazing with his own energy, as if he were a second sun.

sa: रावणश्च दुराधर्षो हतः सबलवाहनः। वानराश्च वशं नीता ऋक्षाश्च सह राक्षसैः॥
en: Rāma has slain the irrepressible Rāvana with his army and brought over the monkeys, bears and Rākşasas to his own side.

sa: प्रबोधयैतान् संसुप्तान् मातरं च परंतप। सर्वानेव गमिष्यामि गृहीत्वा वो विहायसा॥
en: O chastiser of foes, awake your mother and others, sleeping in comfort. Taking them all, I shall go through the sky".

sa: न बुध्येतामुभौ तौ च नगस्थं पन्नगद्विजौ। सह तेनैव वृक्षण भस्मीभूतोऽभवन्नृप॥
en: He was not seen by the Brahmana or the snake. O king, he too was reduced to ashes with the tree.

sa: तदिदं जीवितं तेषां तव किल्विपनाशनम्। सम्मन्तव्यं महाराज पाण्डवानां च दर्शनम्॥
en: O king, therefore the escape of the sons of Pandu from that conflagration and their present reappearance remove your bad repute.

sa: सौहृदान्यपि जीर्यन्ते कालेन परिजीर्यतः। सौहृदं मे त्वया ह्यासीत् पूर्वं सामर्थ्यबन्धनम्॥
en: We had friendship between us when we were both equally circumstances but time that wears out everything, wears out friendship also.

sa: मातलिरुवाच भो भोः शक्रात्मज श्रीमाञ्छक्रस्त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति आरोहतु भवाञ्छीघ्रं रथमिन्द्रस्य सम्मतम्॥
en: Matali said: O lucky one, O son of Shakra, Shakra wants to see you, ascend speedily this car sent by Indra.

sa: प्रसादश्च कृतस्तेन ममैव द्विपदां वर। शरं चोद्धृतवानस्मि तस्य वै द्विजसत्तम॥
en: O foremost of men, thus was he propitiated by me. O best of men, I extricated the arrow from his body.

sa: व्याध उवाच एवं शप्तोऽहमृषिणा तदा द्विजवरोत्तम। अभिप्रसादयमृषि गिरा त्राहीति मां तदा॥ अजानता मयाकार्यमिदमद्य कृतं मुने। क्षन्तुमर्हसि तत् सर्वं प्रसीद भगवन्निति॥
en: The Fowler said: O foremost of the best of Brahmanas, having been thus cursed by the Rishi, I said "Pardon me, O Rishi, I have unconsciously done this wicked act. You should pardon all (my fault). Oexalted Rishi, be graceful (to me).

sa: क्षीणेषु च ब्राह्मणेषु पृथिवी क्षयमेष्यति। ततः पृथिव्यां क्षीणायां त्रिदिवं क्षयमेष्यति॥
en: If the Brahmanas are destroyed, the world will be also destroyed. If the world is destroyed, heaven itself will be destroyed.

sa: न जातु विनिवर्तेत मनोज्ञो ह्यहमस्य वै। अपि चात्र महाराज सव्यसाचिदिदृक्षया॥ सर्वे लालसभूताः स्म तस्माद् यास्यामहे सह। यद्यशक्यो स्थैर्गन्तुं शैलोऽयं बहुकन्दरः॥
en: O great king, I know his character well; he will never return (without you). We are all cager to see Savyasachi (Arjuna) and therefore we will all go together. If we cannot go on our cars over this mountain of many defiles,

sa: तमश्रौषमहं गत्वा यथावृत्तः स दुर्मतिः। मयि कौरव्य दुष्टात्मा मार्तिकावतको नृपः॥
en: Returning there, O descendant of Kuru, I heard all that the vicious-minded and evilsouled king of Martika had said regarding myself.

sa: ततो निवातकवचा वध्यमाना मया युधि। संहृत्य मायां सहसा प्राविशन् पुरमात्मनः॥
en: Thereupon, the Nivatakavachas, thus struck dead by me, all on a sudden, forsook their illusion and entered into their own city.

sa: ततो बाणमयं वर्ष व्यसृजत् तरसा रणे। प्रद्युम्नो भुजवेगेन शाल्वं सम्मोहयन्निव॥
en: Thereupon Pradyumna also overwhelmed Shalva in the battle by a thick shower of arrows shot by the strength of his arms.

sa: स तैरभिहतः संख्ये नामर्षयत सौभराट्। शरान् दीप्ताग्निसंकाशान् मुमोच तनये मम॥
en: The king of Saubha thus attacked did not endure it. He discharged, at my son, arrows that were like blazing fire.

sa: यथाश्रुतमिदं सर्वं समासेन द्विजोत्तम। एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: O excellent Brahmana, I have told you in brief all that I have heard. What else do you desire to hear.

sa: अग्निदाहान्मयं चापि मोक्षयित्वा स दानवम्। सभां तां कारयामास सव्यसाची परंतपः॥
en: Having saved the Danava Maya from the conflagration of fire, the chastiser of foes, Savyasachi (Arjuna) made him build that Assembly-hall.

sa: सत्यवाक्यस्थिताः सर्वे पाण्डवा भरतर्षभ। पितुस्ते वचनं तात न ग्रहीष्यन्ति कर्हिचित्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, all the Pandavas follow the path of truth. They will never accept your father's words.

sa: कुरु क्षिप्रं वचोऽस्माकं ततः श्रेयोऽभिपत्स्यसे। तीर्थानि हि महाबाहो तपोविघ्नकरैः सदा॥
en: O mighty armed hero, Tirthas are infested by Rakshasas ever prone to obstruct ascetic austerities. You should protect us from them.

sa: मातर ऊचुः यास्तु ता मातरः पूर्वं लोकस्यास्य प्रकल्पिताः। अस्माकं तु भवेत् स्थानं तासां चैव न तद् भवेत्।१६।। भवेम पूज्या लोकस्य न ताः पूज्याः सुरर्षभ। प्रजाऽस्माकं हृतास्ताभिस्त्वत्कृते ताः प्रयच्छ न:॥
en: The mothers said: in the days of your, the ladies were appointed as the mothers of creatures. O foremost of deities, we desire that they are disposed of that dignity. Let us be installed in their place. Let us be worshipped instead of them by all the worlds. Restore us our those progeny whom we have been deprived of by thein.

sa: ब्रह्मण्यश्चास्त्रविच्चासि शूरश्चासि कुरूद्वह। अस्त्राणि समवाप्तानि त्वया दश च पञ्च च॥
en: Protector of the Brahmana, skilled in arms and brave, O perpetuator of the Kurus. You have obtained five and ten weapons,

sa: वैषम्यमपि सम्प्राप्ता गोपायन्ति कुलस्त्रियः। आत्मानमात्मना सत्यो जित: स्वर्गो न संशयः॥
en: 'Although fallen into great calamity, the chaste women guard themselves by their own efforts; and thus undoubtedly obtain heaven (heavenly blessings).

sa: न त्वमद्य युधा जेतुं शक्यः सुरगणैरपि। किं पुनर्मानुषे लोके मानुषैरकृतात्मभिः॥
en: "Not to speak of men of imperfect minds dwelling on earth, even the gods are not now capable of conquering you.

sa: शशंस तस्मै पाञ्चाली चिरयातं वृकोदरम्। स प्रतस्थे महाबाहुधौम्येन सहितो नृपः॥
en: The daughter of Panchala answered "Vrikodara has been long out.” Then he of mighty arms, accompanied by Dhaumya left (the place),
